subject: Mythology
title: Disney and the Myth Factory
description: A quick, practical guide to Disney and the Myth Factory.

hook.text: Disney turned folklore and mythology into a global empire, but it changed the originals beyond recognition.

buildup.text: Hercules rewrote Greek mythology for children. Moana brought Polynesian mythology to mainstream audiences worldwide.

discovery.text: The Little Mermaid, Frozen, Mulan, and Brave all draw from mythological and folkloric traditions across cultures.

twist.text: Disney's versions often erase the dark originals. Hercules skips Heracles' madness and the murder of his family.

climax.text: For billions of people, the Disney version is the only version of these myths they will ever know.

punchline.text: Disney became the world's top mythmaker by cutting out what myths are about.

quiz.question: What criticism exists about Disney's use of mythology?
options: Disney only uses European mythology and ignores all others
Disney erases the dark, violent originals and sanitizes the stories for children
Disney charges licensing fees to the cultures whose myths it uses
